name: 038.2 — the world-space family, and follow is absorbed
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 038.2: the three world-space spec kinds ({image = asset}, {model = asset}, {ghost = res}) on the one gob:overlay verb, each read back with its kind and its res; 'offset' shifting it in world units and overlay:pos() reading it back as a difference; the composed entity verbs (:tint/:alpha/:scale/:rotate) chaining on the Overlay object and refused on a screen-space one; a spec naming two kinds refused naming both and one naming none refused naming all five; the same key across the two spaces still leaving ONE overlay; the hard cut of follow= from hafen.render.sprite/object and hafen.ghost.new, each refused NAMING gob:overlay, with the handles' :follow/:offset reading nil and a fixed sprite still building; an overlay's ghost never appearing in hafen.ghost.list(); and the parked park/gone round for the one thing only a person can drive — an overlay dying with its gob when the target despawns.
